content: {"reasoning":"The denial is CO-197, prior authorization missing at time of service. This payer does not offer retroactive authorization and does not offer peer-to-peer review. An appeal with necessity was already tried and the auth requirement is a hard administrative denial, not a medical-necessity dispute. No available action can properly progress this claim, and retro-auth/P2P are unavailable per published rules. Since the auth was never obtained, the balance is not billable to the patient and is a provider write-off.","action":"write_off"}
